question: What liberating effect arises from remembrance of this mantra or deity?
premises: Remembrance of a particular referent is the cause.
Good beings are the subjects affected.
They reach the far shore of the ocean of existence.
inference: By remembrance of this, good beings reach the far shore of the ocean of existence.
uncertainties: The antecedent of 'yasya' (mantra or deity) is determined by context.
plain_english: By remembrance of whom, good beings have reached the far shore of the ocean of existence.
